concerns.text: Task T005 mandates a 'real inference' engine with a hardcoded default model path ('TheBloke/Llama-7B-Chat-GGUF...') and unconditional download logic. This silently weakens Spec Assumption 1 (CPU-only, GitHub Actions free-tier limits) and Assumption 2 (benchmark provides ground-truth answers). The task forces a heavy model download that may fail or timeout in the constrained CI environment, violating the constitutional principle of Computational Efficiency (Constitution VI) and the spec's explicit framing of the study as observational (no generation required if ground-truth exists).

Task T011c defines noise injection as 'replacing' edges. However, the Spec 'Edge Cases' section explicitly states: 'injecting random edges... adding a proportion of random edges to the original graph'. While FR-001 mentions 'replaced', the Edge Cases section (which defines the robustness test methodology) specifies 'adding'. The task adopts the FR-001 phrasing but ignores the specific methodology defined in the Edge Cases, creating a semantic drift where the robustness test (adding noise) differs from the implementation (replacing noise), potentially invalidating the stress test results against the spec's intent.

Task T020 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked as incomplete/missing in the provided text (implied by the 'Analyze Report' context and lack of implementation details compared to other tasks). The Spec Assumptions explicitly mandate a sensitivity analysis sweeping values {0.5, 0.7, 0.9} to ensure robustness. The absence of a concrete task to execute this sweep violates the requirement to test the hypothesis robustly and fails to satisfy the acceptance criteria for the 'Lazy' strategy's validity.

Tasks T024a/b (Statistical Analysis), T025 (Point-Biserial Correlation), and T027 (Threshold & Inflection Analysis) are critical for satisfying Success Criteria SC-003 and SC-004. The 'Analyze Report' indicates these are missing or incomplete. Without these tasks, the system cannot perform the mandated paired t-tests/Wilcoxon tests or calculate the Point-Biserial correlation and inflection point, rendering the core research question (statistical significance of heuristic strategies) unanswerable and violating the spec's mandatory statistical requirements.

Tasks T013b (Noisy Baseline), T019c (Noisy Lazy), and T019d (Noisy Greedy) are essential for satisfying SC-001 and SC-002 (measuring reduction/delta under stress). The 'Analyze Report' flags these as missing/incomplete. Without executing the strategies on the noisy graphs, the system cannot measure the robustness of the heuristics against the baseline under perturbed conditions, violating the Graph Topology Robustness principle (Constitution VII) and the spec's requirement to compare performance on noisy data.
